statusLegend.implemented: Implemented and has at least one direct test or smoke path.
statusLegend.partial: Some behavior exists, but the stable ACP requirement is not fully covered.
statusLegend.not_advertised: The capability is intentionally not advertised; callers must not use it.
statusLegend.external_gap: Requires pi base, ACP SDK, client, or protocol work before adapter conformance is possible.

architecturePrinciples: Prefer pi-acp and pi extension implementations over pi base changes.
Treat pi base work as a fallback only after an extension-owned boundary is proven insufficient.
Write extension-owned ACP services behind narrow interfaces so they can move into pi base later without changing ACP-facing behavior.
Assume a near-base pi installation and provide reusable ACP-facing services that other pi extensions can consume.

entries.name: initialize
entries.next: Add raw JSON-RPC envelope validation for initialize request/response.

entries.name: authenticate
entries.next: Terminal auth is advertised only to SDK-capable clients (`clientCapabilities.auth.terminal`) or legacy Zed `_meta['terminal-auth']` clients. authenticate validates the method id, runs a short pi RPC model-availability probe, returns AUTH_REQUIRED if no authenticated model is available, and auth-required errors reuse the negotiated method set. Keep the probe lightweight and revisit if ACP adds cwd-scoped authenticate params.

entries.name: logout
entries.next: Adapter advertises logout only when no known non-clearable environment or models.json auth sources are configured, clears pi's stored auth.json credentials, and defensively rejects logout if non-clearable sources appear after initialize. A pi base hook would still be useful to replace mirrored auth-source detection with authoritative inventory.

entries.name: session/new
entries.next: Stable session/new requirements are covered: absolute cwd validation, unique session creation through pi state/UUID fallback, SDK-schema response validation, and extension-owned stdio MCP setup. HTTP/SSE remain unadvertised optional transports; native resource UX and registry-level unregister are pi API fidelity risks tracked outside stable v1 setup conformance.

notes: The installed SDK schema contains compatibility, preview, and unstable methods that are not in the audited stable ACP v1 method inventory, including session/fork, document notifications, providers, NES, and MCP-over-ACP surfaces. session/set_model is intentionally served as a compatibility alias for session/set_config_option model selection.
The installed SDK now dispatches stable logout, session/close, session/resume, and session/set_config_option.
Use this checklist as the stable v1 target; track extra SDK surfaces separately from ACP-complete claims.
